# Tantra

> Tantra is an omnichannel outreach platform for conversation-led and invitation-led campaigns. It has two campaign paths: Google Calendar campaigns for RSVP-led outreach, and sequences across Gmail, LinkedIn and WhatsApp, including social-only sequences.

Gmail sequence steps and Google Calendar campaigns send through the customer's own Google Workspace service account with domain-wide delegation, so they go out from their real mailboxes rather than a shared pool.
LinkedIn and WhatsApp steps send through the customer's own linked social accounts. Google Workspace is required only for Gmail or Calendar, so a social-only sequence needs no Workspace tenant.
There are no channel add-ons. Pro includes up to 5 LinkedIn or WhatsApp accounts and Scale up to 15, and you can add more at $20 per additional account per month. Every plan includes unlimited email and calendar accounts.
AI personalization is optional. Customers connect it by signing in with a ChatGPT or Claude account (no API key) or with their own OpenRouter, Cerebras or Novita key; there are no resold AI credits. It applies to email subject and body and Calendar descriptions. Templates, merge tags and spintax work without any AI provider, and social messages are template-based.
There is deliberately no open-pixel tracking. Engagement is measured by clicks, replies and calendar RSVPs.
Zoom and WebinarGeek attendance is refreshed on a user-triggered basis for follow-up attribution.
Pricing is per company rather than per inbox or per seat.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://usetantra.com/): Product overview and how the two campaign paths fit together
- [Features](https://usetantra.com/features): Full capability list for omnichannel sequences and Calendar campaigns
- [Pricing](https://usetantra.com/pricing): Plans, what is never metered, and billing FAQ
- [Integrations](https://usetantra.com/integrations): Google Workspace, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Zoom, WebinarGeek, LLM providers, MCP, webhooks, REST API
- [Omnichannel Sequences](https://usetantra.com/features/sequences): Multi-step sequences mixing Gmail, LinkedIn and WhatsApp steps
- [Unified Inbox](https://usetantra.com/features/unified-inbox): Email and social replies in one threaded queue
- [Deliverability](https://usetantra.com/features/deliverability): Sending caps, address validation, suppression, and mailbox warmup
- [AI Personalization](https://usetantra.com/features/ai): Optional personalization for email subject and body and Calendar descriptions, through a ChatGPT or Claude sign-in or a customer-provided API key
- [Developer Platform](https://usetantra.com/features/developers): Outbound webhooks, REST API with account-level keys, and the MCP server
- [Calendar Campaigns](https://usetantra.com/features/calendar-campaigns): Google Calendar invitation campaigns measured by RSVP
- [Use Cases](https://usetantra.com/use-cases): Index of the jobs Tantra is hired for, with the channels and prerequisites each one needs
- [Cold Email](https://usetantra.com/use-cases/cold-email): Multi-step Gmail sequences sent as your own Workspace mailboxes
- [LinkedIn Outreach](https://usetantra.com/use-cases/linkedin-outreach): Profile visits, connection requests and messages paced per account
- [WhatsApp Campaigns](https://usetantra.com/use-cases/whatsapp-campaigns): Plain-text WhatsApp outreach from a linked account
- [Webinars](https://usetantra.com/use-cases/webinars): Webinar registration outreach, with Zoom and WebinarGeek attendance attributed back to campaigns
- [Help Center](https://usetantra.com/help): Task-oriented documentation, organized by topic
- [Blog](https://usetantra.com/blog): Long-form guides on deliverability and outreach strategy
- [Contact](https://usetantra.com/contact-us): Demo requests, sales and support

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://usetantra.com/help/getting-started): What Tantra is, which outreach channels you can use, and how to run your first campaign.
- [Connect Google Workspace](https://usetantra.com/help/connect-google-workspace): Set up the Google service account and domain-wide delegation that lets Tantra send as your mailboxes.
- [Calendar Campaigns](https://usetantra.com/help/calendar-campaigns): Reach prospects with Google Calendar invitations and track their RSVPs.
- [Cold Email](https://usetantra.com/help/cold-email): Build multi-step email sequences that send from your mailboxes with per-sender limits.
- [Multichannel Outreach](https://usetantra.com/help/multichannel-outreach): Connect LinkedIn and WhatsApp, then add those channels to your outreach sequences.
- [Inbox and Replies](https://usetantra.com/help/inbox-and-replies): Read replies across your outreach channels and keep conversations organized.
- [Contacts and Lists](https://usetantra.com/help/contacts): Import, organize, validate, and suppress contacts across your campaigns.
- [Templates and AI](https://usetantra.com/help/templates-and-ai): Reusable templates, merge tags, spintax, AI personalization, and connecting your own LLM.
- [Deliverability and Tracking](https://usetantra.com/help/deliverability-and-tracking): Click tracking, custom domains, one-click unsubscribe, domain health, and why opens are not tracked.
- [Integrations](https://usetantra.com/help/integrations): Connect Google Calendar accounts, WebinarGeek, and Google OAuth client credentials.
- [API, MCP, and Webhooks](https://usetantra.com/help/api-and-mcp): Issue API keys, connect the Tantra MCP server to Claude or Cursor, and receive outbound webhooks.
- [Billing](https://usetantra.com/help/billing): Choose a plan, manage your subscription, and see which LinkedIn and WhatsApp accounts your plan includes.
- [Troubleshooting](https://usetantra.com/help/troubleshooting): Fix the most common issues across sending, personalization, and connections.
- [Glossary](https://usetantra.com/help/glossary): Plain-language definitions of the terms Tantra uses.
